lines.zh: 我抬起脚，影子扫过半个山坡。
lines.en: I lift a foot and my shadow sweeps half the slope.

lines.zh: 二米四的身躯，走起来像塔在移动。
lines.en: Two point four blocks tall, walking like a moving tower.
I drag myself through the clouds.

lines.zh: 每一步都让林子静一静。
lines.en: Every step quiets the forest.

lines.zh: 我贴着山脊飞，翅膀收在背后。
lines.en: I fly along the ridge with wings folded back.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴在身后划出弧。
lines.en: My tail carves an arc behind me.
I am in no hurry; I have waited a thousand years.

lines.zh: 气在我脚下结成黑色的雾。
lines.en: Ki forms black mist beneath my feet.

lines.zh: 我慢慢升起来，又沉下去。
lines.en: I rise slowly, then settle.

lines.zh: 我经过的地方，草都发黄。
lines.en: Where I pass, the grass yellows.

lines.zh: 我的爪子在地上划出裂痕。
lines.en: My claws score the ground.
I walk in your direction.
I hover with my claws hanging down.
Black ki circles me.

lines.zh: 我张嘴，试了试空气的味道。
lines.en: I open my mouth and taste the air.

lines.zh: 我在听这颗星球的呼吸。
lines.en: I listen to this planet breathe.
My eyes are bright and cold.

lines.zh: 我对这一带的小生物没兴趣。
lines.en: I have no interest in the little creatures here.

lines.zh: 龙的影子落下，虫子都不叫了。
lines.en: My dragon shadow falls and the insects go silent.

lines.zh: 我在等一个值得一战的对手。
lines.en: I wait for a worthy opponent.

lines.zh: 我的角上凝着黑色的光。
lines.en: Black light gathers on my horns.
I close my eyes slowly, then open them.

lines.zh: 我的身体有三层楼那么高。
lines.en: My body stands three stories tall.
I tap the ground with a claw.

lines.zh: 我低头看你，脖子弯成弧。
lines.en: I bend my neck to look down at you.
You are tiny, yet you stand.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛能看进你身体里。
lines.en: My eyes can see into your body.
What wish would you make?

lines.zh: 这里不是你能来的地方。
lines.en: This is not a place for you.
Your ki is weak.
I smile, all rows of teeth.

lines.zh: 你有没有愿望？我可以实现。
lines.en: Do you have a wish? I can grant it.
I never help for nothing.
I raise a claw and pause.
You carry the smell of Dragon Balls.
I look at you for a long time.
I hear your heartbeat clearly.
Do not be afraid; fear will only make you shiver.
The way you lift your head is not bad.
With me here, you should kneel.

lines.zh: 不过，我更喜欢站着的人。
lines.en: Though I prefer people who stand.
Say what you have to say quickly.
The wound glows faintly beneath my scales.

lines.zh: 我退了一小步，地面塌了。
lines.en: I take one small step and the ground caves.
A white mark runs across a scale.
I exhale a breath of black ki.
I narrow my eyes.
You actually reached me.
My claws tighten.

lines.zh: 我笑出声，黑气从齿间漏出。
lines.en: I laugh, black mist leaking between my teeth.
You will pay for that with everything.
The one-star ball is in me.

lines.zh: 你把它举这么高，想给谁？
lines.en: You hold it up so high; for whom?

lines.zh: 我低头闻了一下，就没了兴趣。
lines.en: I lower my head, sniff, and lose interest.
That would not fill a dragon.
Take it away.
What I truly want is the Dragon Balls.

lines.zh: 我伸出一根爪子，把它挑飞。
lines.en: I flick it away with one claw.

lines.zh: 这东西，连我的牙缝都填不满。
lines.en: This won't even fill the gap between my teeth.
Do not test me with that.

lines.zh: 你撞在我腿上，像撞上一座塔。
lines.en: You run into my leg, like hitting a tower.
I do not budge; you bounce off.
My tail sweeps past you.

lines.zh: 这一碰，你该知道差距了。
lines.en: That touch should show you the gap.
I lift my foot to spare you.
I push you aside.
The wind does not move me.
Our shadows overlap for an instant.

lines.zh: 一星龙的死亡球正在成形。
lines.en: A one-star Death Ball is forming.
I am the only one of my kind.

lines.zh: 龙珠里诞生的东西，不需要同伴。
lines.en: Something born of Dragon Balls needs no mate.
I have lived alone too long.
I look at the rift in the sky.
I do not intend to leave offspring.
My power belongs only to me.
I turn my back to you.
There is only one of this dragon.
Wind passes between my scales.
I close my eyes.
I hook it up with a claw.
Such a small thing.
I hold it between my claws and look.
A drop? I have no need.

lines.zh: 我把它抛向空中又接住。
lines.en: I toss it up and catch it.
I will keep this.
I pry it open with a claw.
It is a grain of sand in my grip.
I drop it into my ki.
I do not care for your things.
This little ki dares to resist?

lines.zh: 我抬起手，黑色的球成形。
lines.en: I raise a hand and a black sphere forms.
You have provoked the wrong being.
The death ball is ready.
I open my mouth.
My claws point at you.
Standing still is wise.
I will erase this whole area.

lines.zh: 一星珠的光，指的就是你。
lines.en: The one-star ball's light points at you.

lines.zh: 一星龙珠的光，在你脚下。
lines.en: The one-star dragon's light is at your feet.

lines.zh: 我的影子已经盖上你了。
lines.en: My shadow already covers you.
One finger is enough.

lines.zh: 千年后的第一个目标，是你。
lines.en: The first target in a thousand years is you.
I know where you are.
I follow your movement, slowly.
You hide behind a tree and it burns through.
Blasts in sequence, one after another.
Afterimages are too slow for me.
I can see your ki.
Wherever you run, I know.
I raise a hand and the air grows heavy.
Your ki is shrinking.
I wait for you to gasp.
The ground starts to sink.
There is no road behind you.
The black mist arrives first; I press in after.
Black mist surrounds you.
How many more can you take?
I gather ki into my claws.
I will take my time with the last blow.

lines.zh: 我的爪子划过你的胸口。
lines.en: My claws rake your chest.
One palm drives you into the ground.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴扫断了三棵树。
lines.en: My tail snaps three trees.

lines.zh: 空中连击，你被抛到云下。
lines.en: Aerial combo tosses you below the clouds.
I chase and add another claw.

lines.zh: 这一下，带着一星龙的气。
lines.en: That blow carried the One-Star Dragon's ki.
You blocked it, but you were pushed back.
I fling you away.
My horn strikes your armor.
No hurry; slowly.
This claw is your lesson.
Not dead yet; good.

lines.zh: 这一爪之后，我留着下一爪。
lines.en: After this claw, another waits.

lines.zh: 龙珠的光散开，我从中现形。
lines.en: The light of the Dragon Balls fades and I emerge.
A rift opens in the sky.
The mountain shakes as I come down.

lines.zh: 黑色气雾先铺开，我随后到。
lines.en: Black mist spreads first; I follow.
A thousand years of sleep is over.

lines.zh: 我的身体从云里探出来。
lines.en: My body pushes out of the clouds.
Birds dare not fly and insects dare not sing.

lines.zh: 我睁开眼，看到这片天地。
lines.en: I open my eyes and see this world.
A whole planet, mine to take.

lines.zh: 我抬起脚，踩塌了一片林子。
lines.en: I lift a foot and crush a stretch of forest.
The air here retreats from me.

lines.zh: 我的影子先到，遮住了阳光。
lines.en: My shadow arrives first and blots out the sun.
A one-star dragon's scales are all black light.
I stretch out my body.
My horns cut the clouds apart.
I scratch my chest.
So this is the new world.
I have come, bearing a wish.
Fire burns on me like a tickle.

lines.zh: 我从天上坠落，砸出一个湖。
lines.en: I fall from the sky and leave a lake.

lines.zh: 水只到我膝盖，可它还在涨。
lines.en: The water only reaches my knees, but it keeps rising.

lines.zh: 爆炸在我身侧炸开，我纹丝没动。
lines.en: The blast blooms at my side and I do not stir.

lines.zh: 一支箭撞在我的鳞上，断了。
lines.en: An arrow breaks against my scales.

lines.zh: 咒光在我身上烧出一块焦痕。
lines.en: Spell-light scorches a patch on me.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，可这具身体在空。
lines.en: I do not eat, yet this body runs empty.

lines.zh: 雷落在我角上，我吸了进去。
lines.en: Lightning strikes my horn and I draw it in.

lines.zh: 虚空要吞我，我偏不松手。
lines.en: The void would swallow me, but I will not let go.
